scientific_integrity: Self-contained unrestricted proof and two independent finite algorithms; computation corroborates but does not replace the proof. All historical comparisons are bounded and do not establish absolute priority.
scientific_limitations: Only three simple internally disjoint arms, each with at least one internal vertex; the general connectivity test predates this work; no extension to more arms or constrained connected sets; possible earlier theta-specific trace literature remains unverified.
title: Complete shattered-support polynomial for connected vertex sets of three-path theta graphs
